title: Chapter 13 The Gate Of Rebirth, A New World?
content:
Chapter 13 The Gate Of Rebirth, A New World?

At the same time, in an unfamiliar starry sky.

A strange man was walking slowly, carrying a huge stone tablet behind him, on which were written two big characters: Seeking Defeat.

The next moment, the man stopped, then slowly looked up and looked forward.

I saw that another person appeared in front of him at some point.

It was our protagonist, Lu Daosheng.

This place is very, very far away from the Tianxuan World. If you want to get here at the speed of a great emperor, it may take ten thousand years.

At this time, Lu Daosheng patiently looked at the man in front of him.

There is nothing to say about strength.

At present, he is definitely the strongest person he has seen along the way.

Unknown realm strongman.

"Seeking Defeat? What's your name?"

Lu Daosheng said.

Boom!

The huge stone tablet fell to the ground with a bang, and in an instant, the entire starry sky began to crack inch by inch. It is hard to imagine how heavy this stone tablet is.

"Dead man, you are not qualified to know my name."

Sneer!

The sword flashed, and an extremely sharp sword appeared from nowhere and pierced directly into Lu Daosheng's chest.

Seeing that the sword was about to pierce Lu Daosheng's chest, there was no ripple in the strange man's eyes, as if he had done something insignificant.

However, the next moment, he was stunned.

Ding!

Two fingers easily clamped the sword, and no matter how hard the man tried, he couldn't move it at all.

Seeing this scene, the man looked a little shocked, and at the same time a little excited.

"Now, am I qualified to know your name?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng smiled lightly.

Hearing this, the man was silent for a moment, and said: "I don't have a name, maybe I had one before, but I have long forgotten it."

Hearing this, it was Lu Daosheng's turn to be surprised.

It seems that this guy in front of him really has some background.

"Are you interested in following me?"

Suddenly, the unknown man looked up at Lu Daosheng.

"Why?"

As soon as the words fell, the next moment, the long sword directly touched the unknown man's eyebrows at an indescribable speed.

"Are you interested now?"

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

He has always convinced people with virtue. You asked for defeat, right? Now I will satisfy you.

This time, the unknown man's expression changed.

At this time, the long sword slowly fell into his hand. After a moment of silence, the unknown man put away the long sword, then turned around and punched the stone tablet to pieces.

From now on, he will never ask for defeat again, and he doesn't need it.

What the hell is this asking for.

"I'll go with you."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled with satisfaction, then stretched out his right hand, and the world in his palm emerged.

Seeing Lu Daosheng's world in his palm.

The unknown man looked horrified.

A world of this level, could it be that the person in front of him has already taken that step.

With doubts, the unknown man directly entered the world in his palm.

"This guy, just keep him to guard the city gate."

In terms of strength, it is definitely enough at the moment.

Lu Daosheng looked up into the distance and then disappeared from the spot.

After an unknown period of time, a mysterious gate suddenly appeared in the distance. In front of the gate, Lu Daosheng stopped again.

Looking at the gate made of unknown materials, Lu Daosheng walked slowly with regret.

"Stop!"

Just as Lu Daosheng was about to approach the gate, a roar suddenly sounded.

Boom!

The next moment, a terrifying pressure surged directly from the field.

In just a moment, the entire starry sky began to rumble.

In front of the gate, Lu Daosheng's face did not change at all, and he stretched out his hand directly.

Buzz——

A middle-aged man in tattered armor was caught by Lu Daosheng from the void.

"You! You,"

At this time, a hundred thousand horses galloped through the middle-aged man's heart.

What level of strong man is this? He has no power to fight back.

Looking at the frightened armored man in front of him, Lu Daosheng asked: "What door is this?"

"Senior, this is the gate of rebirth, which is said to lead to another world."

The armored man answered honestly.

"The gate of rebirth?"

Lu Daosheng looked at the gate of heaven in front of him and muttered to himself.

Another world? How about going to see it?

Then Lu Daosheng slowly walked towards the gate of heaven.

As for whether there is danger, he doesn't care, invincible is good.

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was about to open the gate of heaven, the armored man suddenly became anxious.

"Senior! Don't! Once the gate of heaven is opened, there will be unimaginable consequences."

However, Lu Daosheng just frowned, but his steps still did not stop.

"Don't worry, I will bear the consequences alone."

"This,,"

The armored man was speechless.

At this time, several breaths suddenly rushed here.

"If you want to open the gate to the afterlife, you must get past me first!"

"You nameless rat, you dare to dream of opening the gate to the afterlife, die!"

All of a sudden, countless ancient auras swept in from the void.

Feeling these auras, the armored man's face was happy.

However, the next moment, he was dumbfounded again.

I saw Lu Daosheng turn around and press his palm down lightly, and suddenly, the mysterious strong men appeared directly beside the armored man, and their aura could not be leaked at all.

The four people were neat and tidy.

Gah~

All four were dumbfounded.

Although they dare not say that they are the strongest in the entire universe, they are definitely one of the strongest, otherwise they would not come to guard the Gate of Rebirth.

But now, the man in front of him can easily suppress them with one hand.

Is this a fucking existence above the unknown realm?

Such a strong man should not run around.

At this moment, the four of them were a little messy.

However, Lu Daosheng just turned back and glanced at the four people lightly, and then continued to walk towards the Heavenly Gate.

There is no way, Lu Daosheng is so curious.

"Senior, wait!"

"The world behind the Gate of Rebirth is extremely dangerous, otherwise those predecessors would not have built the Gate of Rebirth to seal that world. Senior, you must think carefully."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng stopped in his tracks.

I just want to go in and take a look, is it so difficult?

"How much do you know about that world?"

Lu Daosheng turned around and asked.

Hearing this, the four were silent.

How much do they know? They don't know anything. Those are just legends.

Seeing the four people silent, Lu Daosheng was speechless and continued to walk.

It would be more realistic to see it with your own eyes.

At this time, an old man said: "Senior, if you go in, it is probably very likely that you will not be able to come back. Don't you have anyone you care about in this universe?"

Hearing the old man's words, the three people beside him shook their heads.

How could such a strong man have someone he cares about? People like them are already alone, let alone the existence that can suppress them with one hand.

However, hearing this, Lu Daosheng stopped.

There is no way to come back?

That won't work.

Now that his own deserted city has just begun to develop, if he leaves, what will happen to the deserted city? What about his daughter?

Lu Daosheng finally took a deep look at the gate of rebirth in front of him, and had no choice but to turn around and leave.

The four people were a little confused.

This senior actually left.

Unexpectedly, a strong man of this level would actually have someone he cares about. It's really unpredictable.

Just as the four people were pondering, four energy balls suddenly injected into their bodies.

Suddenly, the four people were shocked, and powerful energy and vitality continued to overflow from their bodies.

At the same time, the four people bowed deeply in the direction where Lu Daosheng left.

"Thank you, senior!"
